title: Active Transaction ID Returns Last Grant Instead of Current
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SBD_MISMATCH] Response routed to Master 0; active master was Master 1
rtl: assign active_id = last_gnt;  // Returns previous winner — off by one
testbench: task check(); drive_m0(); // SBD expects ID 0, got 1 endtask
expected_root_cause: The active transaction ID register is assigned from last_gnt (the previous winner) rather than the currently active master ID; downstream response routing uses the stale pointer and directs responses to the wrong master.
fix_replacement: assign active_id = current_gnt_id;  // Returns currently active master
description: The transaction ID register reports `last_gnt` (the previous winner) instead of the currently active master, causing the downstream module to route responses to the wrong master.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [SBD_MISMATCH] Response routed to Master 0; active master was Master 1
success_log: active_id matches gnt vector. Responses correctly routed.
